reason: An LLM request/response inspection plugin for debugging and monitoring that controls reasoning settings, analyzes streaming traffic, captures thinking data, and optionally persists session audits; human review is warranted because it can intercept and store sensitive model content.

summaries.zh: 用于调试和监控 LLM 请求与响应的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，支持推理控制、流式流量分析、思考内容捕获及会话审计落盘。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for debugging and monitoring LLM requests and responses through reasoning control, stream analysis, thinking capture, and optional session audit persistence.

capabilities: Intercepts and modifies LLM request configuration
Intercepts streaming LLM responses for token, reasoning, and tool-call analysis
Captures and exports model reasoning through a registered think tool
Persists session events and selected request/response content to audit.jsonl
Provides traffic statistics and audit services to other plugins
